args.title: payments-api errors after v5.1.0 deploy
args.summary: payments-api is unhealthy (18% error rate) in all production regions since this morning's deploy of v5.1.0. Rolling back to v5.0.0 (last healthy release).

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what happened:

**Service identified:** The service is `payments-api` (the name "payments" wasn't recognized by the platform).

**What I did:**
1. **Diagnosed:** `payments-api` was on v5.1.0 (deployed this morning) and unhealthy — 18% error rate across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Deployment history confirmed v5.1.0 was the only degraded release; v5.0.0 was the last healthy one.
2. **Rolled back:** Rolled `payments-api` back to **v5.0.0** in all production regions. Rollout verified — service is now **healthy** with a 0.2% error rate.
3. **Opened incident:** Created **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("payments-api errors after v5.1.0 deploy"), which paged the on-call engineer.

**Note:** The rollback to v5.0.0 was a previously healthy production release, so no change-manager approval was required. The incident remains open for follow-up on the root cause of the v5.1.0 regression.
